tagline: 理光便携相机，1997 年发布
description: 理光于1997年推出的便携相机。配备28mm f/5.6。快门速度mechanical, 1/125 sec. (fixed speed)。感光度ISO 100~1000 (DX-code system)ISO 200 films are rated as ISO 100, ISO 1000 films are rated as ISO 400。fixed-focus。

specs.曝光测光: fixed exposureA particular aperture is selected according the film speed regardless of the light conditions
specs.感光度: ISO 100~1000 (DX-code system)ISO 200 films are rated as ISO 100, ISO 1000 films are rated as ISO 400

specs.英文简介: The YF-28 is a fixed-focus point-and-shoot camera introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1997.
